settings.lines.title: Lines
settings.lines.body: The branch each repository's work grows from and lands on: a session's own tree starts there, a merge lands there, and sync feeds the index from it. Unset, git's own guess stands — origin/HEAD, else main, else master.
settings.lines.none: No repository on this machine to set a line for.
settings.lines.workspaceHint: The default for each repository in this workspace that sets none of its own.
settings.lines.from.none: No line: none is set, and git names none here.
settings.lines.saved: In {{name}}, work grows from `{{branch}}` and lands on it now. A session already running keeps its own.
settings.lines.cleared: {{name}} takes its line from what stands above it again.
